precautions: Avoid excess nitrogen and inspect lower leaves

precautions: Monitor boll opening and internal damage

precautions: Inspect fruits regularly

precautions: Observe seedling establishment

precautions: Inspect defoliation symptoms

scoutingFocus: Central whorl and tiny pinholes on young leaves
precautions: Apply seed treatment with Cyantraniliprole; remove alternate grass hosts near field borders.

scoutingFocus: Whorl damage, fecal matter chunks, and long boat-shaped lesions on lower leaves
precautions: Whorl application of sand mixed with lime or poison baits if Fall Armyworm passes economic threshold.

scoutingFocus: Tassel emergence, silk strings, and purplish-brown lesions on leaf sheaths
precautions: Ensure zero waterlogging; strip the lower infected leaves to break fungal contact with soil.

scoutingFocus: Cob tips and stalk stability close to the ground line
precautions: Avoid moisture stress at grain filling to prevent charcoal rot; harvest immediately when black layer forms on grain base.

scoutingFocus: Stem base for water-soaked lesions and young leaves for curling
precautions: Ensure deep summer ploughing; treat seeds with Trichoderma viride or Metalaxyl to protect against damp soils.

scoutingFocus: Sudden wilting of patches or branches; webbing behavior on leaf axils
precautions: Rogue out wilt-infected plants immediately; maintain proper inter-row spacing to minimize microclimate humidity.

scoutingFocus: Flower clusters for drop or chewing damage; mosaic symptoms (pale green leaves with no flowers)
precautions: Install pheromone traps @5 per hectare; spray acaricides early to eliminate the mite vectors spreading sterility mosaic.

scoutingFocus: Bored holes on pods and internal seed damage; premature drying of whole plants
precautions: Monitor pod wall surfaces for tiny egg punctures; ensure need-based systematic insecticide applications before pods harden.

scoutingFocus: Cotyledons and lower leaf margins for hopperburn (yellowing and downward curling)
precautions: Sow resistant varieties like Kranthi or Jyothi; treat seeds with Carbendazim to protect against soil pathogens.

scoutingFocus: Defoliation lines on lower leaves and sudden drooping/drying of upper foliage
precautions: Hand-pick semi-looper larvae in early stages; introduce bird perches throughout the field to promote natural predators.

scoutingFocus: Developing spikes and individual flower structures for grey woolly fungal growth
precautions: Crucial stage during cyclonic rain windows in AP; immediately spray Carbendazim if continuous drizzle or high humidity strikes during flowering.

scoutingFocus: Capsules showing internal frass or browning; concentric spots on top canopy leaves
precautions: Perform sequential picking of matured spikes (racemes) as they dry out to safeguard oil quality and prevent capsule shattering.
